name: AutoPrint: set the AutoPrint address (and optional API token) in "AutoPrint Request"
info:
Needs node-red-contrib-home-assistant-websocket and the Node-RED Companion integration in Home Assistant.

All entities belong to the Home Assistant device **AutoPrint**:
- **AutoPrint drucken** (button): prints the next image. HomeKit Bridge shows it as a switch that turns itself off again, so Siri can trigger it.
- **AutoPrint nächstes Bild** (sensor), refreshed every 15 min and after each print.
- **AutoPrint Drucker erreichbar** (binary sensor, diagnostic).

After the import select your Home Assistant server in the three entity config nodes and in "Benachrichtigung", then deploy.
